title: Modified NEBNext VarSkip Short SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep for Wastewater Samples
author: Padmini Ramachandran
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b34qqqvw
materials: Gently mix and spin down reagents. Prepare the split pool cDNA amplification reactions as described below: For Pool Set A: A B 1 COMPONENT VOLUME 2 cDNA (Step 2) 4.5 µl 3 (lilac) Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix 6.25 µl 4 NEBNext VarSkip Short SARS-CoV-2 Primer Mix 1 1.75 µl 5 Total Volume 12.5 µl For Pool Set B: A B 1 COMPONENT VOLUME 2 cDNA (Step 2) 4.5 µl 3 (lilac) Q5 Hot Start High-Fidelity 2X Master Mix 6.25 µl 4 NEBNext VarSkip Short SARS-CoV-2 Primer Mix 2 1.75 µl 5 Total Volume 12.5 µl

Based on the viral load in the sample, you will see a spectrum of fragment profiles. If there is a single peak around 400-600 bp, the clean-up step can be omitted and you can proceed directly to library preparation using Illumina DNA Prep https://www.protocols.io/edit/modified-illumina-dna-prep-m-tagmentation-library-b2yzqfx6 If there is not a single peak, check the amplicon size distributions. If there are lots of smaller peaks, for example, we typically see one at 44, 75, 128, and 213, these PCR reaction pools need to be cleaned up. Follow the cleanup protocol and prepare libraries using the Ultra II DNA workflow by NEB Next ARTIC SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep Kit (Illumina). If you are not able to perform the PCR pool assessment above, proceed to PCR cleanup and prepare libraries using the Ultra II DNA workflow by NEB Next ARTIC SARS-CoV-2 Library Prep Kit (Illumina).

The presence of genomic DNA or carry-over products can interfere with sequencing accuracy, particularly for low copy targets. Therefore, it is important to carry out the appropriate no template control (NTC) reactions to demonstrate that positive reactions are meaningful. We have also verified cDNA synthesis using the Invitrogen™ SuperScript™ IV First-Strand Synthesis System (Catalog number:18091200), as described in the SNAP protocol with modifications (random hexamers, RT incubation of 30 min.).

steps.title: Prepare cDNA Synthesis Reaction
steps.instruction: Gently mix and spin down the LunaScript RT SuperMix reagent. Prepare the cDNA synthesis reaction using 4.5 µl of cDNA input; if using less, add nuclease-free water to reach a final volume of 4.5 µl.

steps.title: Perform cDNA Synthesis Thermocycling
steps.instruction: Incubate reactions in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to 105°C using the following program:

substeps.instruction: Primer Annealing: 25°C for 2 minutes (1 cycle)
cDNA Synthesis: 55°C for 20 minutes (1 cycle)
Heat Inactivation: 95°C for 1 minute (1 cycle)
Hold: 4°C

steps.title: Perform cDNA Amplification
steps.instruction: Run the cDNA amplification in a thermocycler with the heated lid set to 105°C using the following program:

substeps.instruction: Initial Denaturation: 98°C for 30 seconds (1 cycle)
Denature: 95°C for 15 seconds (35 cycles)
Annealing/Extension: 63°C for 5 minutes (35 cycles)
Hold: 4°C

steps.title: Combine PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Combine the Pool A and Pool B PCR reactions for each sample.

steps.title: Clean Up PCR Reactions
steps.instruction: Perform a bead-based cleanup of the combined PCR reaction (25 µl volume):

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to resuspend.
Add 20 µL (0.8X) resuspended beads to the combined PCR reaction; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortexing for 3-5 seconds on high.
Incubate at room temperature for at least 5 minutes.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until the solution is clear), then discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL 80% freshly prepared ethanol, incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds, and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the ethanol wash once more (total of two washes), ensuring all visible liquid is removed.
Air dry beads on the magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry; beads should remain dark brown and glossy).
Remove from magnetic stand and elute DNA by adding 28 µL 0.1X TE (or 27 µL 0.1X TE if not assessing cDNA in Step 24).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortex, then incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then transfer 26 µL (or 25 µL if not assessing cDNA) to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Assess Amplicon Concentration and Size
steps.instruction: Assess the cleaned cDNA amplicons using a Qubit fluorometer (HS DNA assay kit) or a Bioanalyzer/TapeStation to confirm a size of ~500 bp.

substeps.instruction: For Bioanalyzer: dilute amplicon 10-fold with 0.1X TE Buffer and run 2 µL on a DNA High Sensitivity ScreenTape.

steps.title: Perform End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the End Prep reaction in a sterile nuclease-free tube:

substeps.instruction: Combine 1.5 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix, 3.5 µl NEBNext Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer, and 25 µl Targeted cDNA Amplicons (Total Volume: 30 µl).
Note: If cleanup was skipped, dilute 2.5 µl of pooled cDNA amplicons with 22.5 µl of 0.1X TE to reach 25 µl.
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down 10 times using a 100 µl or 200 µl pipette set to 25 µl, then perform a quick spin.

steps.title: Perform Adaptor Ligation
steps.instruction: Ligate adaptors to the End Prep reaction mixture:

substeps.instruction: Add the Ligation Master Mix and adaptors directly to the End Prep Reaction Mixture (do not premix adaptor with Master Mix).
Mix by pipetting the entire volume up and down 10 times using a 100 µl or 200 µl pipette set to 40 µl, then perform a quick spin.
Incubate at 20°C for 15 minutes in a thermocycler with the heated lid off.

steps.title: Perform USER Enzyme Treatment
steps.instruction: For non-indexed adaptors, treat the ligation mixture with USER enzyme:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL USER Enzyme (red or blue) to the ligation mixture.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes with the heated lid set to ≥ 47°C.

steps.title: Clean Up Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform a bead-based cleanup of the ligation reaction (47.75 µl volume):

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to resuspend.
Add 43 µL (0.9X) resuspended beads to the reaction; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortexing for 3-5 seconds on high.
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard the supernatant.
Perform two washes with 200 µL 80% freshly prepared ethanol (incubate 30 seconds each, then discard supernatant).
Air dry beads on the magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from magnetic stand and elute DNA by adding 10 µL 0.1X TE.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortex, then incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then transfer 7.5 µL to a new PCR tube.

steps.title: Perform Library PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Amplify the library using the following components in a sterile strip tube:

substeps.instruction: Combine 7.5 μl Adaptor Ligated DNA Fragments, 12.5 μl (blue) NEBNext Library PCR Master Mix, and 5.0 μl Index Primer Mix (E6440S) (Total Volume: 25 μl).
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times using a 100 μl pipette set to 20 μl, then perform a quick spin.
Place in a thermocycler and perform PCR amplification.

steps.title: Final Library Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform a final bead-based cleanup of the PCR reaction:

substeps.instruction: Vortex NEBNext Sample Purification Beads to resuspend.
Add 22.5 µL (0.9X) resuspended beads to the PCR reaction; mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortexing for 3-5 seconds on high.
Incubate on bench top for at least 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on a magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then discard the supernatant.
Perform two washes with 200 µL 80% freshly prepared ethanol (incubate 30 seconds each, then discard supernatant).
Air dry beads on the magnetic stand for up to 5 minutes (do not over-dry).
Remove from magnetic stand and elute DNA by adding 17 µL 0.1X TE.
Mix by pipetting up and down 10 times or vortex, then incubate for at least 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic stand for 5 minutes (or until clear), then transfer 15 µL to a new PCR tube and store at -20°C.

steps.title: Final Quality Control
steps.instruction: Check the final library size distribution on an Agilent Bioanalyzer or TapeStation; a peak size of ~520 bp is expected.
